relations.label: dus gsum mkhyen pa (3855) active at dka' brag (6480)
relations.zotero_refs:
[I58Z22ET]: 408-409, n. 42, based on Dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnam thar in Si tu Chos kyi 'byung gnas's Karma kam tshang gser 'phreng (tre ka brag ces bya ba'i bka' gdams kyi dgon pas mkhan po mchog gi bla ma (ID:6479) dang | slob dpon seng ge grags las rab tu byung nas). Dus gsum mkhyen (ID:3855) was ordained at Tre ka brag (ID:7206).
[Y6NGTTC6]: 304. Was ordained and attended mChog gi bla ma (ID:6479) there for two years. 
According to the gSer gling by rGang lo, edited in [Y6NGTTC6]: 100 (dgung lo bcu drug la dka' brag tu dge bshes mchog gi bla ma la dge tshul mdzad nas).
